models_evaluated: LLM prompt-conditioned with publicly available surgical prophylaxis guidelines (unspecified model)

links.outcome: Guideline concordance and clinically significant prescribing risk of LLM surgical prophylaxis recommendations
links.effect: Clinically significant risk in 10% (2/20) of scenarios, including omitted anaerobic coverage and failure to redose in prolonged procedures; overall concordance 4/5, perfect dose accuracy, timing 70%.
links.quote: Clinically significant antimicrobial prescribing risk was identified in 10% of simulated scenarios (2/20), recognising wide confidence intervals due to the small sample size.

links.outcome: Accuracy of guideline citations in LLM outputs
links.effect: Guideline citation accuracy was 45%, the lowest-scoring domain.
links.quote: Overall guideline concordance was 4/5, with perfect dose accuracy but lower performance for timing (70%) and guideline citation (45%).

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates a pre-implementation safety evaluation protocol (using simulated scenarios and clinician-rated harm indices) as a governance practice prior to clinical use of a guideline-prompted LLM.
